:::{#def-argmin}
#### Argmin

Let $f : A \to \reals$ be a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function).
The **argmin** of $f$ over $A$
[@wikipedia_arg_max]
is the set of inputs where $f$ takes its smallest value:

$$\argmin_{x \in A} f(x) \eqdef \cb{x \in A : \all a \in A,\ f(x) \le f(a)}$$

When this set has exactly one element $\hat{x}$,
we write $\hat{x} = \argmin_{x \in A} f(x)$.

:::
